items.title: The projection formula for capping with a first Chern class and proper pushforward
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for a first Chern class against a proper pushforward: pushing forward the cap of the pullback of an invertible sheaf equals capping the pushforward with the Chern class of that sheaf (statement lines 4630-4642, tag 02SU). The proof first isolates the case where the morphism restricts to closed immersions on integral subschemes, then reduces the general case by forming the disjoint unions of the components of the cycle and of their images and observing that the identity on those two disjoint unions implies it for the original morphism, and finally reduces to an integral dominant morphism. The reduction through the disjoint unions is the substance, so the claim is H2.
